guide.tvilas.alarm.text:
In a raid, or with 3 or more monsters nearby, the Mayor rings the bell and calls iron golems: 2 at most (more with upgrades), one at a time.

The village golems get stronger.
guide.tvilas.alarm.title: Alarm
guide.tvilas.alarm_warning.text:
Golems attack anyone who hurts villagers, as in the normal game.

Called golems leave a minute after the alarm and drop no iron.
guide.tvilas.alarm_warning.title: ⚠ Careful
guide.tvilas.alloy_smith.text: Forja only. Bronze, steel, chromium, titanium, stainless steel and tool parts.
guide.tvilas.alloy_smith.title: Alloy Smith
guide.tvilas.baker.text: Buys wheat, sugar, eggs and cocoa. Sells bread, cookies, pies and cake.
guide.tvilas.baker.title: Baker
guide.tvilas.beekeeper.text: Honey, honeycomb, candles and hives. At the top level it sells a bee nest.
guide.tvilas.beekeeper.title: Beekeeper
guide.tvilas.builders.text:
Works paid by the treasury are done by a Builder: he walks to the spot and places the blocks one by one, with dust and sound.

Works: golem, wall and lights.
guide.tvilas.builders.title: Builders
guide.tvilas.builders_night.text:
If nobody is near to watch, the work waits.

What is left appears after the night, when someone sleeps or the day passes.
guide.tvilas.builders_night.title: At night
guide.tvilas.carpenter.text: Móveis only. Chairs, tables, sofas, chandeliers and a double bed, varnished, and varnish brushes.
guide.tvilas.carpenter.title: Carpenter
guide.tvilas.civic_area.text:
The Desk square, Town Hall, Plaza, Market and Tavern belong to the village. Only the Desk's owner and friends build there:
/vila civica amigo adicionar Name

Outside explosions and lava stay out.
guide.tvilas.civic_area.title: Civic area
guide.tvilas.civic_site.text:
The Builder picks a free spot near the center, on natural ground. Never on houses, streets or players' lots.

While watched it places block by block; at night the work moves on by itself.
guide.tvilas.civic_site.title: Where it builds
guide.tvilas.coin_change.text:
Put any notes or coins that reach the price in the trade slots. The villager keeps the price and the change goes to your inventory.

Picking the trade in the list already puts the money in.
guide.tvilas.coin_change.title: Change
guide.tvilas.coin_more.text:
With CubCoin, lots, taxes and missions are in CubCoins too. The Money Changer still swaps emeralds for notes.

Without CubCoin, it all goes back to emeralds.
guide.tvilas.coin_more.title: All in CubCoin
guide.tvilas.coin_trades.text:
With the CubCoin mod, every villager buys and sells in notes and coins instead of emeralds: the game's, this mod's and the traders.

The price is the Exchange Counter's: one emerald is worth 40 CB.
guide.tvilas.coin_trades.title: CubCoin trades
guide.tvilas.commands.text:
/vila opens the board
/vila info
/vila missao aceitar 1
/vila missao entregar 1
/vila terreno comprar
/vila terreno info
/vila divida pagar
/vila muralha cancelar
/vila muralha retomar
guide.tvilas.commands.title: Commands
guide.tvilas.cover.text:
Mayor, missions, owned lots, growing villages, a raid alarm, new traders, works you can watch and a peddler.

It all starts at the Town Hall, in the center of new villages.
guide.tvilas.cover.title: Villages Guide
guide.tvilas.debts.text: Anyone who cannot pay owes it. The debt shows on the board and is charged when there is money.
guide.tvilas.debts.title: Debts
guide.tvilas.decor_village.text: Blocks that paid for a decorating mission now belong to the village: break one and nothing is left to take.
guide.tvilas.decor_village.title: Village decor
guide.tvilas.defend.text:
The defense mission only counts in a real raid: that raid's raiders defeated inside the village. Ordinary monsters do not count.

After you hand in, the Mayor posts a new mission.
guide.tvilas.defend.title: Defending
guide.tvilas.florist.text: Sells all kinds of flowers. At the top level, rare seeds and spore blossom.
guide.tvilas.florist.title: Florist
guide.tvilas.freeze.text:
Owing for a few days freezes your lot: no building or breaking there until you pay.

Pistons and dispensers stop there. Nothing is removed. The Mayor warns you a day before.
guide.tvilas.freeze.title: Frozen lot
guide.tvilas.friends.text:
Inside your lot type:
/vila terreno amigo adicionar Name

To take a friend out, use remover instead. It works even with the friend offline.
guide.tvilas.friends.title: Friends
guide.tvilas.furniture.text:
With the Móveis mod installed, the Tavern and the Square come furnished: chairs, tables, chandeliers and a double bed, varnished.

Without it, they use game blocks.
guide.tvilas.furniture.title: With Móveis
guide.tvilas.golem_build.text: When the village buys a golem, the Builder stacks four iron blocks and a pumpkin. The golem wakes up by itself.
guide.tvilas.golem_build.title: Built golem
guide.tvilas.growth.text:
Each mission or request done gives the village prestige. Every 3, a new resident walks in from the edge of the village.

The board shows how far it is. There is a cap of 40 residents.
guide.tvilas.growth.title: The village grows
guide.tvilas.growth_house.text: The new resident only comes if there is a free bed. Without one, the Mayor orders a simple house, paid by the treasury, on a free spot, and the Builder makes it.
guide.tvilas.growth_house.title: New house
guide.tvilas.guide_book.text: A book and wheat, together on the crafting table, make another Villages Guide.
guide.tvilas.guide_book.title: This book
guide.tvilas.innkeeper.text: Soups, potatoes, milk, beds for the inn and, at the end, a golden apple and a disc.
guide.tvilas.innkeeper.title: Innkeeper
guide.tvilas.levels.text:
Hamlet, then Village, then Town.

Village: 8 villagers and 100 total reputation.
Town: 16 villagers and 400.

The level never goes down.
guide.tvilas.levels.title: Village level
guide.tvilas.lighting.text:
In a Village, the treasury also buys street lights: the Builder sets poles beside the streets.

Without the Industrial mod they are lantern posts.
guide.tvilas.lighting.title: Street lights
guide.tvilas.lighting_industrial.text:
With Industrial they are real lamp posts (biome wood, iron in the desert), joined by aerial wire.

The Town Hall gets 2 solar panels and a battery: they light at night.
guide.tvilas.lighting_industrial.title: Industrial poles
guide.tvilas.lot_animals.text:
Animals, villagers and decorations inside your lot are protected: non-friends cannot hit them, leash them, or carry them off in a bucket or a boat.

Monsters are not protected.
guide.tvilas.lot_animals.title: Animals on lots
guide.tvilas.lot_rules.text:
On your lot, only you and your friends break or place blocks. Machines from the Industrial mod obey too. Lava, fire, explosions and pistons from outside stay out.

The Town Hall square is not for sale.
guide.tvilas.lot_rules.title: Protection
guide.tvilas.lots.text:
On the board, buy the lot you stand on: 16 by 16 blocks with you in the middle, from the bottom of the world to the sky.

Paid in emeralds, or CubCoins with CubCoin. More reputation, cheaper.
guide.tvilas.lots.title: Lots
guide.tvilas.market.text:
Some new villages have a Market: four stalls with the job sites of the new traders.

Jobless villagers take the stalls.
guide.tvilas.market.title: Market
guide.tvilas.mayor.text: A jobless villager who finds the Mayor's Desk becomes the Mayor. One desk per village.
guide.tvilas.mayor.title: The Mayor
guide.tvilas.mayor_taken.text:
If someone carries the Mayor away, click the Desk: if he is somewhere loaded, he comes back to the Town Hall.

Gone for 3 days, a new one comes and the old one stops being Mayor.
guide.tvilas.mayor_taken.title: Mayor taken
guide.tvilas.mechanic.text: Industrial only. Copper wire, cables, pipes, connectors and machine upgrades.
guide.tvilas.mechanic.title: Mechanic
guide.tvilas.merchant.text: Every few days a peddler with a pack donkey comes to the square. He stays a few days and the Mayor tells you when he comes and goes.
guide.tvilas.merchant.title: Village Peddler
guide.tvilas.merchant_diff.text:
The Wandering Trader shows up by chance and leaves fast.

The village peddler comes on schedule, stays in the square and sells rare things: name tags, saddles, discs, keys and mod items.
guide.tvilas.merchant_diff.title: Not the wanderer
guide.tvilas.mission_fair.text:
No mission pays much more than the items are worth on the market, nor more than buying them from villagers.

Cobblestone no longer makes a mission.
guide.tvilas.mission_fair.title: Fair price
guide.tvilas.mission_fund.text:
A new village starts with 200 CB in the mission fund and gains 50 CB a day, up to 400.

So a new village already pays for missions.
guide.tvilas.mission_fund.title: Mission fund
guide.tvilas.mission_limits.text:
Every 4 days the board swaps all missions. Each mission counts once per player in that time; the board shows how long is left.

The village pays up to 400 CB a day: first from the mission fund, then the treasury.
guide.tvilas.mission_limits.title: Limits
guide.tvilas.missions.text:
There are always three: bring items, place blocks in the village and defend it.

Accept first: only what you do afterwards counts. Blocks must still be there when you hand in.
guide.tvilas.missions.title: Missions
guide.tvilas.mod_vendors.text: Four more traders, each only with its mod: Mechanic (Industrial), Alloy Smith (Forja), Carpenter (Móveis) and Money Changer (CubCoin).
guide.tvilas.mod_vendors.title: Mod traders
guide.tvilas.money_changer.text: CubCoin only. Swaps emeralds for notes and back at the Exchange Counter price, no discounts.
guide.tvilas.money_changer.title: Money Changer
guide.tvilas.news.text:
The Mayor tells everyone in the territory, in one chat line: works, peddler, taxes.

E.g.: 🏗 The village is building the town wall.
guide.tvilas.news.title: News
guide.tvilas.old_villages.text:
Place the Desk in a village with no Town Hall, Market, Tavern or Plaza: the Mayor orders what is missing, one at a time, paid by the treasury.

The board shows what is still missing.
guide.tvilas.old_villages.title: Old villages
guide.tvilas.pay_debt.text:
On the board, Pay debt pays it all at once and the lot is back to normal.

Without CubCoin, it is paid in emeralds.
guide.tvilas.pay_debt.title: Paying debt
guide.tvilas.plaza.text: Some new villages get a square with a fountain, a new well, benches and a café table.
guide.tvilas.plaza.title: Square
guide.tvilas.reborn.text:
A village with no villagers comes back: place the Mayor's Desk and a Mayor arrives.

With free beds, one resident arrives per day, up to three. Then the treasury pays for more.
guide.tvilas.reborn.title: Empty village
guide.tvilas.request_money.text: The «!» only shows if the village can pay for the request. Requests change with the board, every 4 days, and pay at most a little above the market.
guide.tvilas.request_money.title: Only with money
guide.tvilas.request_screen.text:
Click the villager with «!»: the request opens, with what it wants and what it pays. Hand in pays from the village, once per player.

Shift+click, or the Trade button, opens the usual trades.
guide.tvilas.request_screen.title: The request
guide.tvilas.rewards.text:
Each mission gives reputation in this village and is paid by the treasury: in CubCoins with the CubCoin mod, in emeralds without it.

Reputation makes the villagers here a bit cheaper.
guide.tvilas.rewards.title: Rewards
guide.tvilas.talk.text:
Right-click the Mayor or the Desk: it opens the Town Hall board with the village status, missions and lots.

The Mayor does not trade.
guide.tvilas.talk.title: Talking
guide.tvilas.tavern.text: New villages may have a Tavern and inn: the Innkeeper's counter, tables, chairs and beds to sleep in.
guide.tvilas.tavern.title: Tavern
guide.tvilas.tax_changes.text:
The trade tax rises a little with each paid work, up to a ceiling (5 percent).

When the treasury is full, the Mayor lowers it again. The board shows why.
guide.tvilas.tax_changes.title: Changing tax
guide.tvilas.taxes.text:
The Mayor charges 1 cent per bed per day in lot houses, and 2 percent of trades in the territory, with villagers or between players.

Without CubCoin, it charges emeralds once the bill reaches one.
guide.tvilas.taxes.title: Taxes
guide.tvilas.territory.text:
The village reaches 400 blocks around the Mayor's Desk: houses far from the center count too.

Server admins change the radius in config/tvilas.json.
guide.tvilas.territory.title: Territory
guide.tvilas.town_hall.text:
Half of new villages start with a Town Hall in the center: a hall with the Mayor's Desk and a bell in the square.

In other villages, craft the Desk and place it near the center.
guide.tvilas.town_hall.title: The Town Hall
guide.tvilas.treasury.text:
Taxes go to the treasury. Once a day the Mayor buys an upgrade: new residents, a village golem or an alarm upgrade.

See the treasury and spending on the board.
guide.tvilas.treasury.title: Treasury
guide.tvilas.unlocks.text:
Hamlet: 4 lots for sale.
Village: 8 lots, bigger missions and 1 alarm upgrade.
Town: 16 lots, the best paid missions and 2 upgrades.

Lots cost more in bigger villages.
guide.tvilas.unlocks.title: Unlocks
guide.tvilas.villager_requests.text: In each batch, one in four villagers with a job makes a request and shows a «!» over the head: the smith wants iron, the farmer wheat or potatoes, the librarian paper or books.
guide.tvilas.villager_requests.title: Villager requests
guide.tvilas.wall.text:
When the village becomes a Town, the Mayor orders a wall with towers around the center.

It is built little by little, paid by the treasury block by block.
guide.tvilas.wall.title: Town wall
guide.tvilas.wall_cancel.text:
Anyone with a lot or reputation in the village can cancel the wall on the board. What was built stays.

It can be resumed there too.
guide.tvilas.wall_cancel.title: Cancel
guide.tvilas.wall_safety.text:
The wall never breaks or replaces player blocks, nor anything inside lots. It only takes air, grass, flowers and snow.

It goes around things or leaves a gap. Streets become gates.
guide.tvilas.wall_safety.title: Safe wall
